trust_requirement: Exact independently approved non-root federated principal, MFA/IdP assurance and session duration enforcement; no account-root trust and no existing legacy principal. Trust policy cannot be rendered until that principal is approved.
boundary_requirement: Rendered allow set must also be the maximum boundary; explicitly deny non-approved actions/resources and privilege escalation. Current file is a policy template, not an attached/effectively evaluated boundary.
emergency_authority: NOT GRANTED. Bootstrap IAM/bucket-policy repair requires separately reviewed time-limited exact-resource authority, two-person review, rollback plan and fresh DevF authorization; never an automatic gate bypass.
